children: On September 17, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it no longer complies with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after 30 consecutive business days below that level. BeyondSpring has 180 days, until March 16, 2027, to regain compliance, with trading continuing on Nasdaq and potential eligibility for an additional 180-day period.
